- Success
- Path Efficiency
- Average Speed
- AD

Interpret AD as angular dispersion. Restrict attention to:
- Combined
- ICMS Only
- Dim Visual Only
- Bright Visual Only
- Sham

- ANOVA-style comparisons
- post-hoc analysis
- a multiple-comparison correction strategy
- a predictive model for stimulation paradigm based on the performance variables
